_comment: Vanilla Minecraft 1.19 recipe chains. Shared across arms. No Place subgoals. Wood is generic log/planks so verify.py species mapping applies. 1 coal smelts 8 items, enough for every task below.

shared_through_iron_pickaxe.sticks: 4 planks → 8 stick (4 planks left). wooden/stone/iron/diamond pickaxe each need 2 stick → 8 stick; golden sword needs 1 extra from the leftover after iron pickaxe.
shared_through_iron_pickaxe.fuel: 1 coal_ore → 1 coal; coal smelts 8. diamond pickaxe uses 3, golden sword 3+2=5, compass 3+4=7, lava bucket 3.

_derivation.Craft 1 diamond pickaxe: shared + Mine 3 iron_ore → Smelt 3 (iron_ingot) → iron_pickaxe (3 ingot+2 stick) → Mine 3 diamond → diamond pickaxe (3 diamond+2 stick). Sticks: 8−2−2−2−2=0.
_derivation.Craft 1 golden sword: shared through iron_pickaxe + Mine 2 gold_ore → Smelt 2 → golden sword (2 gold_ingot+1 stick). Smelts 5/8 coal. Sticks: 8−2−2−2−1=1 leftover.
_derivation.Craft 1 compass: shared through iron_pickaxe + Mine 4 iron_ore → Smelt 4 + Mine 1 redstone_ore → compass (4 iron_ingot+1 redstone). Smelts 7/8 coal. Sticks: 8−2−2−2=2 leftover.
_derivation.Collect 1 lava bucket: shared through furnace+fuel (no iron pickaxe) + Mine 3 iron_ore → Smelt 3 → bucket (3 iron_ingot) → Collect 1 lava_bucket. Sticks: 8−2−2=4 leftover.

Craft 1 diamond pickaxe._comment: See _derivation. Diamond ore needs iron pickaxe. 1.19 iron ore drops raw_iron.

Craft 1 golden sword._comment: Gold ore requires iron pickaxe. See _derivation.

Craft 1 compass._comment: Compass=4 iron ingots+1 redstone. Redstone ore requires iron pickaxe. See _derivation.

Collect 1 lava bucket._comment: Bucket=3 iron ingots. No iron pickaxe. See _derivation.
